item.title: Readme
item.description:
Hi, my name is Zhizheng Liu (刘知正). I am currently a fourth-year Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Vision and Autonomy Intelligence Lab (VAIL) at UCLA. Before that, I earned my bachelor’s degree from the SJTU-UM Joint Institute (now SJTU Global College) and my master’s degree from ETH Zurich.

I work on a fundamental problem in embodied AI: How to enable general intelligent agents to understand and interact with humans in the physical world?. To address this challenging problem, my PhD research focuses on closing the real-to-sim gap for human-centric robotics with data-driven simulation. To this end, my work involves monocular 4D human-scene reconstruction, using the reconstructed data for generative modeling of pedestrian motion, and transferring these digital twins into simulation environments for scalable robot training and evaluation.
